title: Mathematics Fundamentals
description: Review key concepts in algebra, geometry, and arithmetic.

sections.heading: Order of Operations (PEMDAS)
sections.content: When solving mathematical expressions, follow this order: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication/Division (left to right), Addition/Subtraction (left to right). For example: 3 + 4 × 2 = 3 + 8 = 11, not 14.

sections.heading: Linear Equations
sections.content: A linear equation has the form ax + b = c. To solve for x, isolate the variable by performing inverse operations on both sides. Example: 2x + 5 = 13 → 2x = 8 → x = 4.

sections.heading: Slope and Lines
sections.content: The slope of a line measures its steepness. In y = mx + b, m is the slope. A positive slope goes up, negative goes down. Parallel lines have equal slopes; perpendicular lines have negative reciprocal slopes.

sections.heading: Factoring
sections.content: Factoring breaks expressions into simpler multiplied parts. Difference of squares: a² - b² = (a-b)(a+b). Example: x² - 9 = (x-3)(x+3).

sections.heading: Basic Geometry
sections.content: Area of a rectangle = length × width. Area of a triangle = ½ × base × height. Circumference of a circle = 2πr. The Pythagorean theorem: a² + b² = c² for right triangles.

practice_questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with base 10 and height 6?
What is the slope of y = -2x + 5?
practice_questions.explanation: In y = mx + b form, m = -2 is the slope.
